text: The Board confirms that each of these nominees is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. On behalf of the Board, I respectfully request that the City take the necessary steps to appoint these nominated candidates. Please note that Pam Hrick has resigned (end-of-term), effective September 27, 2023.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following individual to the 519 Church Street Community Centre Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending December 16, 2026 and until a successor is appointed: - Tom Spence 2. Appointed the following individuals to the 519 Church Street Community Centre Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending September 29, 2027 and until successors are appointed: - Vanshika Dhawan - Natalie Miller - Zoe Robinson - Brett House - Jaris Swidrovich
